lines.text: Planners say they will go to a city, spend a year there, and carry on business for profit.
James says life is a mist that vanishes, so they should say, "If the Lord is willing."
James calls their boasting wise, and says anyone who knows the right thing yet fails to do it is guilty of sin.
James tells the rich to weep, because thieves have stolen their clothes and their corroded gold and silver will testify against them.
The rich withheld the workers' wages, lived in luxury, and condemned and murdered the righteous, who did not resist.
